test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Asian Games 2022 held in which country?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Asian Games 2022** was held in **Hangzhou, China** from **September 10 to 25, 2022. **
 
• This was the** third time **China hosted the Asian Games. 
 
• The previous two were in** Beijing in 1990** and **Guangzhou in 2010.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **India:** India has hosted the Asian Games** twice, in 1951 and 1982.**
 
• **Japan:** Japan has hosted the Asian Games **four times**, in** 1958, 1974, 1994, and 2007.**
 
• **Singapore**: Singapore has** never** hosted the Asian Games.
